$comment: T1.4: which evidence proves each CONTRACT-ENFORCED invariant of mako-design/blueprint/INVARIANTS.md (r8).
script/check-invariants.mjs, in CI, fails unless these entries are exactly its pinned invariant list (and,
where the design repository is checked out alongside, exactly INVARIANTS.md's table), every named test is a
real public test function in the rounds and settlement suites, every corpus row and script exists, every
invariant has evidence that runs in CI or a deferral naming its owner. The mutation sweep proves that the

mutants it LISTS are killed; two adversary passes found 20 more that the suite missed, so it is evidence, not proof, that nothing else survives. Courier-side invariants (N15, N20, N21, N24) are proved
source: mako-design/blueprint/INVARIANTS.md, revision r8 (2026-09-18), table 'Enforced by the contract'

N1.note: INVARIANTS.md's names test_RejectsReportTheVerifierRejects .. test_DecodesVerifiedBytesNotInput are corpus rows, run by test_LibraryAgreesWithTheCorpusOnEveryMockRow against the shipping library and by script/rule-reference.mjs independently. The fork tests skip offline and run with MAKO_FORK_RPC (Type B2). The four fork tests skip in CI; the corpus rows and the non-fork tests carry N1 there.

N1c.note: test_FirstValidSettlementWins is test_RoundSettlesAtMostOnce with test_LastSecondSettleWinsAndIsFinal; test_NoOwnerOverride is check-surface.mjs, which asserts the whole external ABI and so that no owner or setter exists.

N7.note: check-surface.mjs: the external ABI has no setter; every SPEC §4 value is declared constant or immutable; the storage layout equals an exact allowlist, so a §4 value moved into storage fails; and the creator set, the one §4 value that must live in storage, is written only in the constructor. The last three were added after the second T1.4 adversary pass turned MAX_ACTIVE_ROUNDS into a storage variable written inside schedule and passed the old ABI-only check.

N8.note: One reentrancy test per value-moving function: enter, settle, claim, withdrawTreasury. finalizeRefund moves no value (it only sets state; the money leaves through claim), so it carries no guard and needs no reentrancy test.

N10.note: check-surface.mjs: no pause function in the ABI, and (since T1.4) no pause-like identifier anywhere in MakoRoundsV1.sol or RoundSettlement.sol source, comments removed. A gate under an innocent name inside one of the six allowed writers is not detectable by this script and is left to review.

N11.note: test_ExpiryIsEnforcedByTheLibraryNotTheVerifier is a fork test and skips in CI (MAKO_FORK_RPC unset); the corpus rows accept-at-expiry-boundary and reject-expired-by-one-second carry the expiry clause in CI.

deferred.reason: a deploy-script assertion; no deploy script exists until T1.5 deploys to testnet

N17.note: test_ConservationSettled is testFuzz_ConservationSettled; test_RemainderOnLastClaim is test_RemainderWaitsForTheLastWinner; test_ConservationRefund covers each refund reason (added at T1.4). Until the second T1.4 adversary pass every claim test settled UP; test_DownWinnersArePaidAndTheRemainderIsSwept claims on a DOWN win, and test_FeesAreFlooredAndTakenOnTheSmallerSideWhicheverItIs checks the fee formula against independent values with DOWN the smaller side.

N18.note: MAX_LEAD had no test until test_MaxLeadAtTheBoundary; test_LeadBoundsAreEnforcedAtTheBoundaryPlusMinusOne steps by a minute despite its name, so test_MinLeadAtOneSecond pins MIN_LEAD at one second either side. Both added after the T1.4 adversary pass.

N19.note: test_AnotherCreatorCannotTakeThisRoundsFee (added after the T1.4 adversary pass) claims as a second invited creator; before it, no test did, and a mutant paying the fee to any creator survived the suite.

deferred.reason: the deployed USDC address and code-hash assertion is a deploy-script check; no deploy script exists until T1.5

N26.note: testFuzz_AnyCallerSameOutcome compares the outcome, prices and hashes; test_TheSettlerCannotChangeTheFees (added after the T1.4 adversary pass) compares protocolFee, creatorFee, distributable and the treasury accrual across four settlers, including the round's creator.

N27.note: test_StartTimeOnMinute checks a minute +/- 1 second, which a 30-second step would also pass; test_HalfMinuteIsRejected (added after the T1.4 adversary pass) rejects hh:mm:30.
